scheme.name: National Fertilizer Subsidy Programme
scheme.administering_body: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development / NCPB

label.en: Original National ID card (not a photocopy)

documents.issuer: Department of Immigration and Citizen Services

how_to_obtain.en: Replace a lost ID at your sub-county registration office. A waiting card is not accepted at the gate.
how_to_obtain.sw: Badilisha kitambulisho kilichopotea katika ofisi ya usajili ya kaunti ndogo. Kadi ya kusubiri haikubaliwi getini.

label.en: Your name on the NCPB farmers register for this county
label.sw: Jina lako kwenye daftari la wakulima la NCPB la kaunti hii

how_to_obtain.en: Register free of charge at your County, Sub-county or Ward Agricultural Office.
how_to_obtain.sw: Jisajili bila malipo katika ofisi ya kilimo ya kaunti, kaunti ndogo au wodi.

documents.issuer: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development

how_to_obtain.en: Register through an agricultural officer, or by dialling the subsidy USSD code and giving your land size.
how_to_obtain.sw: Jisajili kupitia afisa wa kilimo, au kwa kupiga namba ya USSD ya ruzuku na kutoa ukubwa wa shamba lako.

label.sw: Namba ya e-voucher uliyopokea kwa SMS

documents.issuer: Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development

how_to_obtain.en: Issued by SMS once your registration is verified. Without the code the depot cannot serve you.
how_to_obtain.sw: Hutumwa kwa SMS baada ya usajili wako kuthibitishwa. Bila namba hiyo, depo haiwezi kukuhudumia.

label.en: A way to pay without cash - M-Pesa on your own phone, or a bank deposit slip
label.sw: Njia ya kulipa bila pesa taslimu - M-Pesa kwa simu yako mwenyewe, au hati ya malipo ya benki

how_to_obtain.en: Cash is not accepted at the depot. Pay to the NCPB till number displayed at the depot, or deposit at the bank the depot manager names.
how_to_obtain.sw: Pesa taslimu hazikubaliwi deponi. Lipa kwa namba ya till ya NCPB iliyoonyeshwa deponi, au weka pesa benki aliyoitaja meneja wa depo.

label.sw: Mkataba wa kukodisha shamba uliotiwa saini

how_to_obtain.en: A written agreement signed by the land owner, showing the acreage you farm.
how_to_obtain.sw: Mkataba ulioandikwa na kutiwa saini na mwenye shamba, ukionyesha ukubwa wa shamba unalolima.

label.en: Stamped letter from your Chief confirming you farm the land
label.sw: Barua yenye mhuri kutoka kwa Chifu ikithibitisha unalima shamba hilo

how_to_obtain.en: Ask your Chief or Assistant Chief. The letter must carry the office stamp, not only a signature.
how_to_obtain.sw: Muulize Chifu au Chifu Msaidizi. Barua lazima iwe na mhuri wa ofisi, sio saini pekee.

message.en: You must hand over your original National ID at the depot counter. A photocopy or a waiting card will be refused.
message.sw: Lazima utoe kitambulisho chako halisi cha kitaifa kwenye kaunta ya depo. Nakala au kadi ya kusubiri itakataliwa.

remedy.en: Register free of charge at your County, Sub-county or Ward Agricultural Office first.
remedy.sw: Jisajili bila malipo katika ofisi ya kilimo ya kaunti, kaunti ndogo au wodi kwanza.

message.en: Your name must already be in the NCPB farmers register. The depot cannot add you at the gate.
message.sw: Jina lako lazima liwe tayari kwenye daftari la wakulima la NCPB. Depo haiwezi kukuongeza getini.

remedy.sw: Jisajili kupitia afisa wako wa kilimo.

message.en: You must be registered on KIAMIS. The e-voucher is issued from that register.
message.sw: Lazima uwe umesajiliwa kwenye KIAMIS. E-voucher hutolewa kutoka daftari hilo.

remedy.en: Check your SMS inbox before you travel. If no code has arrived, your registration is not yet verified.
remedy.sw: Angalia SMS zako kabla ya kusafiri. Kama namba haijafika, usajili wako haujathibitishwa.

message.en: You need the e-voucher code sent to you by SMS. Without it the depot has nothing to redeem.
message.sw: Unahitaji namba ya e-voucher iliyotumwa kwako kwa SMS. Bila hiyo, depo haina kitu cha kukomboa.

remedy.en: Pay to the NCPB till number displayed at the depot, or to the bank account the depot manager gives you.
remedy.sw: Lipa kwa namba ya till ya NCPB iliyoonyeshwa deponi, au akaunti ya benki utakayopewa na meneja wa depo.

message.en: Cash is not accepted at the depot, and you must pay before collecting. Carry a phone with M-Pesa, or pay in at the bank first.
message.sw: Pesa taslimu hazikubaliwi deponi, na lazima ulipe kabla ya kuchukua mzigo. Nenda na simu yenye M-Pesa, au lipa benki kwanza.

remedy.en: The registered farmer must travel with their own ID.
remedy.sw: Mkulima aliyesajiliwa lazima asafiri na kitambulisho chake.

message.en: You cannot buy subsidised fertiliser for somebody else. The registered farmer must come in person.
message.sw: Hauwezi kununua mbolea ya ruzuku kwa niaba ya mtu mwingine. Mkulima aliyesajiliwa lazima aje mwenyewe.

remedy.en: Choose a depot inside your registration county.
remedy.sw: Chagua depo iliyo katika kaunti yako ya usajili.

message.en: This depot is not in the county where you are registered. You can only collect within your registration county.
message.sw: Depo hii haiko katika kaunti uliyosajiliwa. Unaweza kuchukua mbolea tu katika kaunti yako ya usajili.

message.en: You can only be served in the county where you registered. Confirm this depot is in that county before you travel.
message.sw: Unaweza kuhudumiwa tu katika kaunti uliyosajiliwa. Hakikisha depo hii iko katika kaunti hiyo kabla ya kusafiri.

remedy.en: Travel on a weekday and arrive before 5.00pm.
remedy.sw: Safiri siku ya kazi na uwahi kabla ya saa 11 jioni.

message.en: The depot is closed on the day you plan to travel. Depots open Monday to Friday, 8.00am to 5.00pm.
message.sw: Depo imefungwa siku unayotaka kusafiri. Depo hufunguliwa Jumatatu hadi Ijumaa, saa 2 asubuhi hadi saa 11 jioni.

remedy.en: Ask your Chief or Assistant Chief for a stamped letter.
remedy.sw: Muulize Chifu au Chifu Msaidizi barua yenye mhuri.

message.en: Farmers on leased or unregistered family land are often asked for a stamped letter from the Chief. Carry one if you can.
message.sw: Wakulima wanaolima shamba la kukodi au la familia lisilosajiliwa mara nyingi huombwa barua yenye mhuri kutoka kwa Chifu. Chukua moja ikiwezekana.

remedy.en: The stamp from the Chief usually goes on this agreement.
remedy.sw: Mhuri wa Chifu huwekwa kwenye mkataba huu.

message.en: On leased land, carry the signed lease agreement showing the acreage you farm.
message.sw: Kwa shamba la kukodi, chukua mkataba uliotiwa saini ukionyesha ukubwa wa shamba unalolima.

message.en: The bag figure below is your whole entitlement for the season. If you have already collected some bags, subtract them yourself - this app cannot see your record.
message.sw: Idadi ya mifuko iliyo hapa chini ni haki yako yote ya msimu. Kama umechukua mifuko awali, punguza mwenyewe - programu hii haioni rekodi yako.
Kuuza tena mbolea ya ruzuku ni kinyume cha sheria.
